source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The newer accepted updateOAuthUI returns after a custom OAuth override, clears provider extension information, and makes the OAuth option visible. hasCustomOAuth uses different UI settings for IMAP/POP and EWS/Graph. This is a current refinement checked alongside 828, not a claim that the later customization landing was fully studied. A hostname-only whitelist would lose this precedence.
title: Keep custom OAuth configuration ahead of provider lookup
